schema.description: MUT-02 complete mutant catalog: the 20 Wave-3 intents (M01-M20) plus the eight §16 AR-001 mutants (M21-M28). Each entry is a controlled single-change mutation whose observable failure a named stable test ID must detect by delta against a green layer baseline. Corrections: M06 now injects a revision-bumping write (the old write-back of an unchanged entity was unobservable); M15's anchor now targets the W4 unlink branch (the old anchor matched the validation dispatch); M20 mutates only the malformed-JSON classification site (the old blanket rename duplicated class ApiError and died at compile time, not from behavior).

fields.expectedTestIds: stable test IDs (bracket testCase IDs, matrix IDs, or inventory slugs) that must NEWLY fail versus the green layer baseline for the kill to count
fields.intendedCatchingLayer: layer whose suite/proof must kill the mutant
fields.layer: source layer the mutation is applied to (frontend | conformance | backend-ada). backend-ada and frontend mutants run that layer's suite; conformance mutants run the tooling vitest config (conformance/src + conformance/scripts).
fields.restorationHash: map of mutated file (repo-relative) to its sha256 at catalog time; the harness verifies it before applying and after restoring every mutant
fields.severity: P0 = correctness/data-integrity, P1 = contract/spec violation or important UX, P2 = polish/edge
fields.target: verified exact current file + symbol/selector (no guessed line numbers)
